item.title: [IGNITE-10007] Deactivation hangs if an open transaction exists
item.description:

2. Activate cluster
3. Connect sqlline
4. Create table create table t1(a int, b varchar, primary key(a)) with "ATOMICITY=TRANSACTIONAL_SNAPSHOT,backups=1";
3.Start TX and execute a DML commnd:

begin;
insert into t1 values (1, '1');

item.summary: Deactivation hangs if an open transaction exists

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
skozlov, I failed to reproduce the issue, see the test attached - it uses JDBC to simulate sqlline, and GridClient to simulate control.sh. Everything works as expected - deactivation hangs until TX is committed. Commit fails with relevant exception, then deactivation finishes.

Could you please attach thread dumps from both nodes and a client (control.sh)? One more thing - could you double-check that the problem is reproducible with one node? This will simplify debug.

More details:
The issue is reproduced for one node as well.
LRT is still presented if sqlline is running (even commit has been executed)

Improved test is attached which reproduces the problem. Root cause: GridQueryProcessor.querySqlFields - it doesn't allow to execute COMMIT on deactivated cluster, hence we cannot finish transaction. Need to move that check deeper inside H2 indexing and make sure that it is not performed for COMMIT/ROLLBACK commands.
